question: What is the full form of URL?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uniform Resource Locator**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of the **URL** is **Uniform Resource Locator**.
 
• URL serves as a web address that identifies the **location of a specific resource on the internet**, such as a **web page, image, or document.**
 
• A URL consists of different components, including the **protocol **(such as "http://" or "https://"), the **domain name**, and the **path to the specific resource**.
 
• By using a URL, users can **access and retrieve web content **by entering the URL in a web browser, enabling seamless navigation and retrieval of information on the internet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some other Important full forms are as follows:
 
 
• **RAM:** Random Access Memory
 
• **ROM:** Read-Only Memory
 
• **CPU:** Central Processing Unit
 
• **GPU:** Graphics Processing Unit
 
• **BIOS:** Basic Input/Output System
 
• **LAN: **Local Area Network
 
• **WAN: **Wide Area Network
 
• **USB: **Universal Serial Bus
 
• **HDMI: **High-Definition Multimedia Interface
 
• **SSD: **Solid State Drive
